findings.summary: The inverse-tangent formula used gegenüber and angrenzend instead of the standard German terms Gegenkathete and Ankathete used by the other formulas and explanation.
evidence: The inverse-sine and inverse-cosine formulas used Gegenkathete and Ankathete, but inverse tangent used different descriptive labels.
findings.resolution: Changed the inverse-tangent formula to Gegenkathete / Ankathete.

findings.summary: The worked trigonometry example used descriptive side labels instead of the standard German terms used in the section.
evidence: The example used gegenüber and angrenzend while the explanatory text and formulas used Gegenkathete and Ankathete.
findings.resolution: Aligned both example labels with Gegenkathete and Ankathete.
